public_packages.name: I18N

public_packages.name: I18N.Runtime

primary_subprograms.name: Initialize
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Initialize (Runtime : in out I18N.Runtime.Instance; Catalog_Path : String)
primary_subprograms.behavior: Reads, validates, and compiles a line-oriented catalog into indexed runtime entries. Invalid catalogs put the runtime into a deterministic invalid state.

primary_subprograms.name: Initialize_Binary_File
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Initialize_Binary_File (Runtime : in out I18N.Runtime.Instance; Catalog_Path : String)
primary_subprograms.behavior: Reads a versioned I18N-CATALOG-BINARY envelope with format_version=1, ir_version=1, and payload=text or payload=hex-text, then initializes from the canonical text payload. Unsupported envelopes put the runtime into a deterministic invalid state.

primary_subprograms.name: Load_File
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Load_File (Item : in out Instance; Path : String; Result : out Load_Result; Policy : Duplicate_Policy := Reject_Duplicates)
primary_subprograms.behavior: Transactionally layers a catalog shard from a file under a duplicate policy; non-destructive on failure.

primary_subprograms.name: Load_Binary_File
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Load_Binary_File (Item : in out Instance; Path : String; Result : out Load_Result; Policy : Duplicate_Policy := Reject_Duplicates)
primary_subprograms.behavior: Transactionally layers a versioned binary catalog shard after envelope validation and payload decoding; non-destructive on failure.

primary_subprograms.name: Load_Text
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Load_Text (Item : in out Instance; Source_Name : String; Text : String; Result : out Load_Result; Policy : Duplicate_Policy := Reject_Duplicates)
primary_subprograms.behavior: Transactionally layers an in-memory catalog shard; non-destructive on failure.

primary_subprograms.name: Validate_Catalog_File
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Validate_Catalog_File (Path : String) return Catalog_Validation_Result
primary_subprograms.behavior: Parses and validates a catalog file without mutating any runtime; diagnostics include line numbers.

primary_subprograms.name: Validate_Binary_Catalog_File
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Validate_Binary_Catalog_File (Path : String) return Catalog_Validation_Result
primary_subprograms.behavior: Validates a versioned binary catalog envelope and its canonical text or hex-text payload without mutating any runtime.

primary_subprograms.name: Validate_Catalog_Text
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Validate_Catalog_Text (Source_Name : String; Text : String) return Catalog_Validation_Result
primary_subprograms.behavior: Parses and validates catalog text without mutating any runtime.

primary_subprograms.name: Validate_Binary_Catalog_Text
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Validate_Binary_Catalog_Text (Source_Name : String; Text : String) return Catalog_Validation_Result
primary_subprograms.behavior: Validates in-memory versioned binary catalog envelope text and its canonical or hex-text payload without mutating any runtime.

primary_subprograms.name: Load_Data_Text
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Load_Data_Text (Source_Name : String; Text : String) return Data_Load_Result
primary_subprograms.behavior: Transactionally installs process-wide deterministic runtime-data overrides before generated CLDR/tzdb fallback data.

primary_subprograms.name: Load_Data_File
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Load_Data_File (Path : String) return Data_Load_Result
primary_subprograms.behavior: Loads process-wide deterministic runtime-data overrides from a file; reports Data_Source_Not_Found or Invalid_Data without changing prior overrides.

primary_subprograms.name: Clear_Runtime_Data
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Clear_Runtime_Data
primary_subprograms.behavior: Clears all process-wide runtime-data overrides.

primary_subprograms.name: Resolve
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Resolve (Item : Instance; Locale : I18N.Locales.Locale_Id; Key : String) return Resolve_Result
primary_subprograms.behavior: Reports whether a key resolves through canonicalized locale fallback without rendering it; no arguments required.

primary_subprograms.name: Render
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Render (Item : Instance; Locale : I18N.Locales.Locale_Id; Key : String; Arguments : I18N.Arguments.Arguments) return I18N.Result.Render_Result
primary_subprograms.behavior: Renders a catalog key using deterministic canonicalized locale fallback, locale-aware plural/selectordinal, deterministic number/currency formatting, and deterministic date/time formatting with quoted skeleton literals; returns structured status/text.

primary_subprograms.name: Render_Into
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Render_Into (Item : Instance; Locale : I18N.Locales.Locale_Id; Key : String; Arguments : I18N.Arguments.Arguments; Target : in out String; Last : out Natural; Status : out I18N.Result.Render_Status)
primary_subprograms.behavior: Allocation-free render directly into caller-owned storage; reports Buffer_Overflow with the prefix that fits.

public_packages.name: I18N.Result
public_packages.role: Stable public result and status model
contract_notes: Render_Result is a bounded, non-discriminated public result value; use Output_Text(Result.Text) to read the meaningful rendered string.

public_packages.name: I18N.Arguments
contract_notes: Arguments is a limited, mutable, noncopyable public argument map; callers update it with Set/Clear, use Copy for explicit duplication, and pass it by reference to Render.
Set_Integer/Set_Natural write strict decimal text with no 'Image leading space; Set_Boolean writes true/false. These helpers are deterministic and not locale-aware.

Formatted arguments are supplied as strings: number/currency/duration/byte-size/unit/measure-unit/relative-time values use strict integer or decimal text, date values use YYYY-MM-DD or ISO instant text, time values use HH:MM/HH:MM:SS[.fraction] or ISO instant text, datetime values use ISO instant text, and list values use non-empty pipe-delimited item text.
